tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Section and page background. Sections alternate black and white down the page (hero black, about white, experience black…); set the section's data-theme to switch every token below with it. Source: bg-black / bg-white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings, body copy, links and icons on ground. 21:1 in both themes. Source: text-white / text-black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground: dates, locations, taglines, role context, language levels, section intros on black. 8.3:1 on black, 4.8:1 on white. Source: text-gray-400 on black, placeholder-gray-500 on white.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Summary text one step below ink, such as the article description in the writing listing, on ground. Source: text-gray-300 on black; the white-section value (gray-700) is derived, the site never sets soft text on white.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The structural 1px line: bordered cards, outline buttons, chips, the top rule over each role and article, the underline under sub-headings. Always full ink, never grey. Source: border-white / border-black.

tokens.name: rule-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet separators that carry no meaning: the footer's copyright divider, rows of a definition list, the border around a cover image. Decorative, so below 3:1 by design. Source: border-gray-800; white value from the print sheet's bg-gray-200.

tokens.name: rule-quiet
tokens.usage: Border of secondary chips and the secondary (repo) button on ground. The black-section value is the source's border-gray-600 and reaches only 2.6:1, under the 3:1 control-border floor; kept exact, the label inside carries the meaning. White value derived to meet 4.8:1.

tokens.name: solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the solid button (the one filled control, Send on the contact form). Source: hover:bg-gray-800 on white; the black-section value is derived.

tokens.name: header-scrim
tokens.usage: Background of the fixed header bar in every section: black at 90%, text inside stays white. Source: bg-black bg-opacity-90.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px by ground, on inputs, buttons and links. Full ink, so 21:1 on either ground. Source: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-2.

tokens.name: prose-ink
tokens.usage: Running text of long-form article pages on ground; a hair softer than ink so paragraphs sit below headings. 16.9:1 on black. Source: article body #e8e8e8; the white value is derived (articles are dark-only).

tokens.name: prose-muted
tokens.usage: Article meta line (date · reading time), language switcher, article footer text on ground. 7.5:1 on black, 6.5:1 on white. White value derived.

tokens.name: prose-lede
tokens.usage: The lede paragraph and notices under an article title on ground. White value derived.

tokens.name: prose-link
tokens.usage: Links in article footers and inactive language links, on ground. White value derived.

tokens.name: prose-em
tokens.usage: Emphasised (<em>) text inside prose. White value derived.

tokens.name: prose-hairline
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside articles: <hr>, footer rule, cover and code borders. Decorative. White value derived.

tokens.name: tag-border
tokens.usage: Border of the uppercase article tags. Decorative (1.9:1 on black, kept exact from the source); the tag text carries the meaning.

tokens.name: tag-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the uppercase article tags on ground. 10:1 on black. White value derived.

tokens.name: code-surface
tokens.usage: Inline <code> background, with a prose-hairline border and 2px radius. White value derived.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Inline code text on code-surface.

tokens.name: pre-surface
tokens.usage: Code block panel. There is no syntax highlighting: monospace on this panel is the whole treatment. White value derived.

tokens.name: pre-ink
tokens.usage: Code block text on pre-surface.

tokens.name: table-rule
tokens.usage: Cell borders of tables inside articles. White value derived.

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: Header-row fill of article tables, with ink text in Space Grotesk 500. White value derived.

tokens.name: print-banner
tokens.usage: A4 CV page only: the top name banner, white text on it. Not for screens.

tokens.name: print-sidebar
tokens.usage: A4 CV page only: the left column fill, print-ink on it.

tokens.name: print-ink
tokens.usage: A4 CV page only: body text on white and print-sidebar. Print never uses pure black text.

tokens.name: print-muted
tokens.usage: Printed home page: what ink-muted becomes under @media print, on white.

tokens.name: print-rule
tokens.usage: Printed pages: section-title underlines and every border, on white.

families.body: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-name
styles.usage: The person's or product's name in the hero. 30px on phones, 36px from md, 48px from lg.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: One per section, centred, 48px below it before content. 36px/40px on phones. Light weight is the signature: headings whisper, borders do the structuring.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Job title or product line under display-name. 20px from phones, 24px md, 30px lg.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles of roles, project cards, skill groups, sub-section headings. Medium is the heaviest weight headings take.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: Degree names, fact-card figures, the header's name (at 300).

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: Agentic AI & LLM Platforms · TypeScript / AWS · Hamburg, fully remote
styles.usage: One line under the hero title, in ink-muted. 16px on phones.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chip buttons, nav, language switcher, meta lines (date · min read). Always Space Grotesk, never uppercase on the home page.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Everything below is in daily or recent production use, not a wish list.
styles.usage: Default paragraph size on the home page: intros, role descriptions, bullet points, form labels. Inter Light.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Longer pieces, written up properly rather than left as notes.
styles.usage: Fact-card details, skill chips, footer copy.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Role context lines and technology chips, usually in ink-muted.

styles.name: article-h1
styles.sample: Catching AI Workflow Failures with Executable Playbooks
styles.usage: Article title: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 2.75rem). Unlike the home page, long-form headings are medium weight.

styles.name: article-h2
styles.usage: Section heading inside an article, 56px above, 16px below.

styles.name: article-h3
styles.usage: Sub-heading inside an article, 40px above, 12px below.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.sample: Record a human's approval, freeze the prototype and cut the stories.
styles.usage: Blockquotes: Space Grotesk in ink with a 2px ink rule on the left.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase back link and language switcher on static pages.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Uppercase article tags, tag-ink inside a tag-border box.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: A file-based delivery procedure for Claude Code and Codex that turns workflow preconditions into executable checks.
styles.usage: Article body in prose-ink, 48rem measure, 21.6px between paragraphs. 16px under 640px. Bold is 600 in ink.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A file-based delivery procedure for Claude Code and Codex that turns workflow preconditions into executable checks, with explicit limits.
styles.usage: The paragraph under an article title, in prose-lede.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks (12px under 640px). Inline code is 0.875em of its paragraph.

styles.name: print-body
styles.sample: Led a team of six building a multi-agent platform.
styles.usage: A4 CV body text in print-ink. Arial, because print output must not depend on web fonts.

styles.name: print-section
styles.usage: A4 CV section titles: uppercase, 1.5px print-rule underline.

styles.name: print-name
styles.usage: Surname in the A4 CV banner; the first name sits above it at 24pt 300.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of technology chips (py-1).

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of chip buttons and skill chips (py-1.5).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; label to input; underline gap under sub-headings.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal chip padding; button vertical padding; input padding (p-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Chip-button horizontal padding; header padding; gap in fact grids; phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Fact-card padding (p-6); space between form fields and between icons.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding (p-8); grid gap between cards; button horizontal padding; top padding under each role's rule; section side padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section heading to content; between roles; before a section's closing button; md column gutter.

tokens.name: section-pad-y
tokens.usage: Section top and bottom padding from 1024px (48px md, 40px phones).

tokens.name: section-pad-x
tokens.usage: Section side padding from 1024px (64px md, 32px phones).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: cards, buttons, chips, inputs, images, the header. The system is square; do not round corners.

tokens.name: radius-code
tokens.usage: Inline code only, the single exception.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border: cards, chips, buttons, inputs, rules.

tokens.name: border-quote
tokens.usage: The left rule of a blockquote; also the focus ring width.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Max width of an article column (with 20px side padding, 16px under 640px).

tokens.name: measure-list
tokens.usage: Max width of the writing listing (max-w-4xl).

tokens.name: measure-intro
tokens.usage: Max width of a centred section intro (max-w-2xl; max-w-3xl, 48rem, for the skills intro).

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Tailwind container at 2xl; below that it snaps to 640/768/1024/1280px.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons, with cursor not-allowed.

tokens.name: opacity-icon-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a bare icon link (the header's print link).
